# Gaia Knowledge Ingest Checklist

- [ ] The feedback or learning item is documented with clear context, rationale, and scope.
- [ ] If a few-shot example was added, it is placed in `knowledge/examples/<topic>.md` with zero placeholder comments (`TODO`, `TBD`).
- [ ] If an operational convention was added, it is registered in `knowledge/learnings/conventions.md`.
- [ ] If a new skill was forged, it followed `hephaestus-build-skill` with mandatory headings and checklist assets.
- [ ] No plaintext secrets or confidential environment variables were committed.
